Master-O is a sales enablement platform used by leading enterprises across industries like FMCG, Pharma, Banking, Insurance, Automotive, Retail, Technology etc. to drive the capability development and frontline readiness for their customer-facing teams with the help of microlearning, game-based assessments and AI-powered conversational roleplays.

This is a high-ownership role for someone who enjoys building features, solving complex engineering problems, and collaborating with internal teams and customers. You will be leading a team of 5-6 developers and will be the face of the engineering function at Master-O.
Reporting directly to the Founder, this role requires someone who can balance engineering excellence with business priorities and ensure reliable delivery across multiple enterprise clients and geographies.
We are particularly interested in people who have prior worked in a growing SaaS organisation or have entrepreneurial experience and understand what it takes to build and deliver features from scratch.

Lead a team of 5-6 engineers, providing technical direction, reviewing code, ensuring timely delivery and nurturing their career path. Remain hands-on with development and debugging rather than functioning solely as a people manager. Establish engineering standards, development practices, testing protocols, and release processes. Make pragmatic technology decisions that balance long-term scalability with ad-hoc business requirements. 
 2. Enterprise Implementations & Client Delivery Own the technical execution of our implementations with enterprise clients across the globe. Drive client-specific configurations, integrations, customizations, deployments, and production rollouts. Work closely with the Founder, Customer Success team, Product team, and other key stakeholders to translate client requirements into robust technical outcomes. Experience integrating Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), and AI agents into enterprise applications will be a strong advantage. Understand the practical considerations of deploying AI in production, including data security, reliability, latency, cost, and evaluation. Solid understanding of backend architecture, REST APIs, database design, system integrations, and cloud-based deployments. Familiarity with software development lifecycle practices, version control, automated testing, CI/CD, and production monitoring. Ability to make independent technical decisions and take ownership of issues from identification through resolution.

Experience in a B2B SaaS company or an enterprise technology environment is strongly preferred. Experience managing enterprise client implementations, integrations, and production deployments. B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline, preferably from a Tier-1 engineering college. 
 What We Are Looking For: 
We are looking for a seasoned engineering professional who has experience handling multiple clients, varied integration requirements, competing priorities, and production issues.
You must be flexible to coordinate across time zones and work outside standard business hours when client implementations or critical releases require it.
This role offers the opportunity to work closely with the Founder, influence the product and architecture decisions, lead a compact engineering team, and directly shape how our technology scales across enterprise customers in not just domestic but international markets.

Job Description: Senior Applied AI Engineer Experience:  5+ Years
 Employment Type:  Full-Time
 Location:  Gurugram

 About Panamoure Panamoure Group LLP is a UK-based business transformation consultancy specialising in private equity-backed portfolio companies. Our India Delivery Centre in Gurugram serves as the engineering and automation backbone for global operations, delivering intelligent process automation, AI-driven workflows, data engineering, Power Platform solutions, and digital transformation initiatives. Role Overview We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer  to design, build and run AI-powered solutions for our clients, from early proof of concept to production. You will work across the full stack: data, models, application logic and the interfaces people use, with a focus on solutions that are reliable, secure and measurably useful. Responsibilities Design, build and deploy solutions using large language models, taking them from proof of concept to production. Build pipelines that process unstructured and structured data, such as documents, transcripts, emails and databases, and turn it into reliable, structured output. Develop retrieval and search solutions, choosing the right approach for each problem. Build agentic workflows and tool-using AI systems where they add real value. Create evaluation frameworks and monitoring that track output quality, cost and latency in production. Build user-facing applications, APIs and dashboards that put AI output in front of users. Turn prototypes and proofs of concept into maintainable, production-grade systems. Set and uphold engineering standards for version control, testing, deployment, monitoring and documentation. Make sure solutions meet security, privacy and responsible AI requirements, including data protection, access control, defence against prompt injection and appropriate human oversight. Assess new models, tools and techniques, and advise on feasibility, model selection and build-versus-buy decisions. Work with business and client stakeholders to turn problems into practical technical solutions. Must-Have Technical Skills Python:  Production-level Python, with strong software engineering fundamentals: system design, testing and code quality. LLM Engineering:  Experience with commercial and open-source models, such as Anthropic, OpenAI and Azure OpenAI, including prompt design, structured outputs, tool use, and managing cost, latency and failures. Retrieval and Search:  Embeddings, vector databases, chunking and hybrid search. Evaluation and Observability:  Test sets, automated quality checks and production monitoring of AI systems. Unstructured Data Processing:  Document parsing, OCR and working with transcripts. Full-Stack Development:  TypeScript and React or an equivalent framework, plus API design. Cloud and DevOps:  At least one major cloud platform, CI/CD, containers, and secrets and environment management. Security and Responsible AI:  Data protection, access control and AI-specific risks such as prompt injection. Nice-to-Have Agent Frameworks:  Frameworks and protocols such as LangGraph or the Model Context Protocol (MCP). Open-Source Models:  Fine-tuning and hosting open-source models. Classical ML and NLP:  Techniques such as classification and entity extraction. Data Engineering:  SQL, data modelling and pipeline orchestration. Microsoft Ecosystem:  Azure AI services, Microsoft 365 integration and Power Platform. Speech and Vision:  Experience with speech or vision models. Client Exposure:  Consulting or client-facing experience. What This Role Is Not This is not a data science or machine learning research role. We are not looking for people whose main experience is building statistical models or training models from scratch.

title: Artificial Intelligence Engineer
description:
About Drishti IAS Drishti IAS is one of Indias most trusted institutions for UPSC Civil Services preparation, serving lakhs of aspirants through classroom programmes, a bilingual (Hindi and English) digital platform, daily current-affairs content, test series and video learning. We are bringing intelligent, reliable and multilingual learning experiences to our students and making our editorial, operations and support workflows dramatically more efficient through AI. 
 About the Role We are looking for a hands-on AI Engineer with 1 to 3 years of experience who can take LLM-based systems from idea to production. You will split your time roughly equally between two tracks: student-facing AI products such as doubt-resolution assistants, answer-writing evaluation, personalised study aids and voice/vision-enabled learning; and internal automation that accelerates content creation, data pipelines and business operations. You will own the full stack of an AI feature: data, retrieval, models, serving, evaluation and monitoring. 
 Key Responsibilities LLM & RAG systems: Design, build and maintain retrieval-augmented pipelines over Drishtis large content corpus, including notes, current affairs, PYQs and test series. Own chunking, embedding, hybrid search, re-ranking and citation quality, and set up offline/online evaluation and production monitoring for accuracy, hallucination and latency. Agentic workflows & automation: Build tool-using agents with LangChain/LangGraph or similar SDKs, expose capabilities via MCP, and automate editorial, marketing and support workflows on platforms such as n8n, Dify or Zapier. Inference & deployment: Deploy and serve open-weight models on GPU infrastructure using vLLM, Transformers or llama.cpp. Handle quantisation, batching, KV-cache and throughput, latency and cost trade-offs. Fine-tuning: Create high-quality datasets from in-house material and fine-tune LLMs using SFT, LoRA, QLoRA and preference tuning for domain, tone and Hindi-English tasks. Evaluate rigorously against baselines before release. Multimodal integration: Integrate speech tools for STT/TTS, including Whisper and ElevenLabs, for voice-based learning and dictation. Integrate image-generation and editing models, including diffusion models and Nano Banana, for content and creative workflows. Data engineering: Build pipelines that ingest and process large volumes of text, audio and long documents. Design schemas and queries across PostgreSQL/MySQL and vector databases such as pgvector, Qdrant and Milvus. System design & reliability: Design scalable, observable services with clean APIs. Add logging, tracing, cost tracking and guardrails. Apply secure-by-default practices, including prompt-injection defences, secrets management and least-privilege access for tools and agents. Collaboration: Work closely with subject-matter experts, editors and product stakeholders, and document systems clearly. 
 Required Skills & Experience Python: Strong, production-quality Python skills, including typing, async, packaging and testing. Comfortable with FastAPI or a similar framework. Automation platforms: Hands-on experience with n8n, Dify, Zapier or comparable low-code/workflow tools, including custom nodes and webhooks. RAG end-to-end: Experience building, evaluating and monitoring RAG systems using RAGAS, custom evaluations or LLM-as-a-judge approaches. Strong SQL skills with PostgreSQL/MySQL and practical experience with vector databases. Agent frameworks: Experience with LangChain, LangGraph or similar SDKs/ADKs, such as Google ADK, OpenAI Agents SDK or Pydantic AI. Knowledge of function/tool calling and Model Context Protocol (MCP). System design: Ability to design and reason about services, queues, caching, data flow and failure modes for AI applications. Inference engineering: Experience deploying local/open-weight models using vLLM, Transformers or llama.cpp. Knowledge of GPUs, VRAM budgeting, quantisation formats such as GGUF, AWQ and GPTQ, and CUDA basics is a plus. Fine-tuning: End-to-end experience in dataset construction and cleaning, training using PEFT, TRL, Unsloth or Axolotl, and evaluation. Vision & voice models: Experience integrating diffusion/image models, such as Stable Diffusion, FLUX and Nano Banana, along with STT/TTS models, such as Whisper, ElevenLabs and Indic TTS, into applications. Large-scale & long-context data: Experience handling high-volume corpora and long sequences through batching, streaming, context management and long-context model usage. Agentic systems: Experience with multi-step agents, tool usage, memory, planning loops and safe execution boundaries. ML/DL fundamentals: Basic understanding of machine learning and deep learning, including training loops, loss functions, embeddings, transformers and evaluation metrics. 
 Good to Have Experience with Hindi or other Indic-language NLP, transliteration and multilingual embeddings. Experience with Docker, Linux, CI/CD, Git workflows and cloud GPU providers such as AWS, GCP, Azure or RunPod. Familiarity with LLM application observability tools, such as Langfuse, LangSmith and Arize Phoenix, and prompt/version management. Awareness of AI security, including OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, prompt-injection and data-exfiltration risks, output filtering and red-teaming. Open-source contributions, personal projects, blogs, Kaggle work or hackathon experience in GenAI. 
 Who You Are You are ship-oriented and prefer a working prototype today over a perfect design next month, followed by iteration using evaluations. You are curious and current on model releases, benchmarks and tooling, and understand when not to use an LLM. You are rigorous about quality, measure before making claims, and treat hallucinations, latency and cost as bugs. You are a clear communicator who can explain technical trade-offs to non-technical educators and stakeholders. 
 What We Offer Ownership of AI products used by lakhs of UPSC aspirants, with real-world impact on learning outcomes. Access to dedicated GPU infrastructure, a rich proprietary content corpus and freedom to experiment with open-weight models. Competitive compensation, a learning budget and a growth path towards Senior AI Engineer or AI Lead roles.
